chapterInfo.content:
26
Nyankopɔn man no anidasoɔ
1 # Yes 60.18 Ɛda no na wɔbɛto dwom yi Yuda asase soɔ sɛ:
Kuro a ɛyɛ den wɔ yɛn,
ɔde nkwagyeɛ ayɛ
afasuo ne epie.
2 # Dwom 118.19 Monhini apono no
na tenenee man a wɔkora gyidie no nhyɛne mu.
3Deɛ n’adwene tim wo soɔ
na wobɛkora no asomdwoeɛ a ɛdi mu mu,
ɛfiri sɛ wo so na ɔde ne ho toɔ.
4 # Deut 32.4 Momfa mo ho nto AWURADE so daa daa,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn
ne daa botan.
5Na ɔde wɔn a wɔtete soro ahwe fam,
kuro a ɛkorɔn no,
wabrɛ no ase;
wabrɛ no ase ama no aduru fam,
wama no aka fam mfuturo;
6wɔde nan tiatia so,
mmɔborɔfoɔ nan,
ahiafoɔ anammɔn no.
7Ɔteneneeni kwan yɛ tee,
wo na wototo ɔteneneeni tempɔn.
8 # Dwom 37.4 Nso w’atemmuo kwan so
na yɛhwɛ wo AWURADE kwan,
yɛn kra ani gyina
wo din ne wo nkaeɛ.
9Me kra ani gyina wo anadwo,
aane, me mu honhom nso, mede mefe wo,
na sɛ w’atemmuo ka asase a,
wiasefoɔ sua tenenee.
10Sɛ wɔdom ɔbɔnefoɔ a,
ɔnsua tenenee;
nsɛntenenee asase so na ɔdi amumuyɛsɛm,
na ɔnhunu AWURADE kɛseyɛ.
11O AWURADE, womaa wo nsa so,
nanso wɔnhunu;
ma wɔnhu wo man anem, na wɔn ani nwu;
ma w’atamfoɔ ho nimkuntwe nhye wɔn sɛ ogya.
12AWURADE, wobɛhyehyɛ asomdwoeɛ ama yɛn,
na yɛn nneyɛɛ nyinaa nso, woawie ama yɛn.
13O AWURADE, yɛn Nyankopɔn,
awuranom a ɛnyɛ woɔ abɛdi yɛn so,
nanso wo nko ara na yɛkamfo wo din.
14Wɔawuwu na wɔrentena ase;
nsamanfoɔ ne wɔn, wɔrensɔre bio;
ɛno nti na wobɛtwee wɔn aso sɛee wɔn
na womaa wɔn ho nkaeɛ nyinaa yeraeɛ.
15O AWURADE, woama ɔman no adɔre,
woama ɔman no adɔre, w’anim aba nyam,
woatrɛ asase no ahyeɛ nyinaa mu.
16 # Yes 28.19; Hos 5.15 O AWURADE, ahohia mu wɔhwehwɛɛ wo,
wɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ
berɛ a woreka wɔn anim no.
17 # Yoh 16.21; Adi 12.2 Sɛdeɛ onyinsɛnfoɔ
a ɔbɛn awoɔ
kyem na ɔtea mu ne yea mu no,
sɛdeɛ yɛteɛ, wo, AWURADE, anim ne no;
18 # Mika 4.10 yɛnyinsɛnee, yɛkyemee;
ɛte sɛdeɛ yɛawo mframa.
Yɛntumi nnyee asase nkwa,
na wiasefoɔ nyinaa ahwehwe ase.
19 # Hes 37.1-14; Adi 20.12 W’awufoɔ bɛnya nkwa,
wɔn afunu bɛsɔre;
monnyane nto ahurisie dwom,
mo a mote mfuturo mu!
Na wo bosuo yɛ hann bosuo,
na asase bɛyi nsamanfoɔ agu.
20 # Dwom 57.1 Me man, kɔ na kɔhyɛne wo mpia mu,
na toto w’akyiri apono mu;
fa wo ho hunta kakraa bi
kɔsi sɛ abufuo no bɛtwam akorɔ.
21Na hwɛ, AWURADE refiri n’afa
akɔtwe asase sofoɔ aso, wɔn amumuyɛ nti.
Na asase bɛyi ne mogya adi,
na ɛrenkata wɔn a wɔaku wɔn ɛsoɔ no so bio.

Ɛda no na wɔbɛto dwom yi Yuda asase soɔ sɛ:
Kuro a ɛyɛ den wɔ yɛn,
ɔde nkwagyeɛ ayɛ
afasuo ne epie.
Monhini apono no
na tenenee man a wɔkora gyidie no nhyɛne mu.
Deɛ n’adwene tim wo soɔ
na wobɛkora no asomdwoeɛ a ɛdi mu mu,
ɛfiri sɛ wo so na ɔde ne ho toɔ.
Momfa mo ho nto AWURADE so daa daa,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn
ne daa botan.
Na ɔde wɔn a wɔtete soro ahwe fam,
kuro a ɛkorɔn no,
wabrɛ no ase;
wabrɛ no ase ama no aduru fam,
wama no aka fam mfuturo;
wɔde nan tiatia so,
mmɔborɔfoɔ nan,
ahiafoɔ anammɔn no.
Ɔteneneeni kwan yɛ tee,
wo na wototo ɔteneneeni tempɔn.
Nso w’atemmuo kwan so
na yɛhwɛ wo AWURADE kwan,
yɛn kra ani gyina
wo din ne wo nkaeɛ.
Me kra ani gyina wo anadwo,
aane, me mu honhom nso, mede mefe wo,
na sɛ w’atemmuo ka asase a,
wiasefoɔ sua tenenee.
Sɛ wɔdom ɔbɔnefoɔ a,
ɔnsua tenenee;
nsɛntenenee asase so na ɔdi amumuyɛsɛm,
na ɔnhunu AWURADE kɛseyɛ.
O AWURADE, womaa wo nsa so,
nanso wɔnhunu;
ma wɔnhu wo man anem, na wɔn ani nwu;
ma w’atamfoɔ ho nimkuntwe nhye wɔn sɛ ogya.
AWURADE, wobɛhyehyɛ asomdwoeɛ ama yɛn,
na yɛn nneyɛɛ nyinaa nso, woawie ama yɛn.
O AWURADE, yɛn Nyankopɔn,
awuranom a ɛnyɛ woɔ abɛdi yɛn so,

Wɔawuwu na wɔrentena ase;
nsamanfoɔ ne wɔn, wɔrensɔre bio;
ɛno nti na wobɛtwee wɔn aso sɛee wɔn
na womaa wɔn ho nkaeɛ nyinaa yeraeɛ.
O AWURADE, woama ɔman no adɔre,
woama ɔman no adɔre, w’anim aba nyam,

O AWURADE, ahohia mu wɔhwehwɛɛ wo,
wɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ
berɛ a woreka wɔn anim no.
Sɛdeɛ onyinsɛnfoɔ
a ɔbɛn awoɔ
kyem na ɔtea mu ne yea mu no,
sɛdeɛ yɛteɛ, wo, AWURADE, anim ne no;
yɛnyinsɛnee, yɛkyemee;
ɛte sɛdeɛ yɛawo mframa.
Yɛntumi nnyee asase nkwa,
na wiasefoɔ nyinaa ahwehwe ase.
W’awufoɔ bɛnya nkwa,
wɔn afunu bɛsɔre;
monnyane nto ahurisie dwom,
mo a mote mfuturo mu!
Na wo bosuo yɛ hann bosuo,
na asase bɛyi nsamanfoɔ agu.
Me man, kɔ na kɔhyɛne wo mpia mu,
na toto w’akyiri apono mu;

Na hwɛ, AWURADE refiri n’afa

Na asase bɛyi ne mogya adi,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
